description: MAIze: mobilenet_v2_cbam-UNet + Grad-CAM for Maize Disease Detection

preprocessing.description: Apply to every input image before inference

step1_resize.description: Resize longest side to target, pad shorter side with zeros

preprocessing.step3_layout: NHWC — shape [1, H, W, 3] (channels last). TFLite always uses NHWC. The ONNX→TF→TFLite conversion automatically transposes from PyTorch NCHW to TFLite NHWC.
preprocessing.clahe_note: CLAHE is applied in the training pipeline but NOT required at inference — the model has learned to handle lighting variation through augmentation.
preprocessing.exif_note: Apply EXIF orientation correction before resizing.

output.name: logit
output.description: Raw logit — apply sigmoid to get P(maize)

post_processing.step3: if probability < 0.7 → REJECT: show 'Not a maize leaf'

bouncer.threshold_note: Empirically selected on validation split to maximise specificity subject to maize recall ≥ 95%.

heuristic_prefilter.description: Run this BEFORE neural bouncer (microseconds, saves battery)
heuristic_prefilter.action_if_fail: Reject immediately without calling TFLite model

segmentation.channel_0: Leaf silhouette — sigmoid → binary boundary mask
segmentation.channel_1: Symptom mask    — sigmoid → binary symptom region

severity.post_process: value is already clamped [0,1]; severity_pct = value * 100
severity.note: Severity is a model-learned estimate consistent with HSV-derived pseudo-labels. Not agronomically validated.

grad_cam_note.description: Grad-CAM++ heatmap is computed at runtime in the Android app, not stored in TFLite.
grad_cam_note.target_layer: Last convolutional block of the mobilenet_v2_cbam encoder
grad_cam_note.target_layer_note: For mobilenet_v2: features[-1]; for efficientnet_b2: blocks[-1]; for resnet: layer4. Check train_student.py GradCAMWrapper for exact hook point.
grad_cam_note.library: Use tflite-support or compute gradient manually
grad_cam_note.app_display: Show as semi-transparent amber overlay labelled 'Diagnostic attention'
grad_cam_note.seg_display: Show segmentation channel_0 as green contour labelled 'Symptom boundary'

inference_pipeline.step3: Run heuristic pre-filter (green coverage + aspect ratio)
inference_pipeline.step4: If heuristic fails: show 'Point camera at a maize leaf'
inference_pipeline.step8: If Bouncer fails: show 'Not detected as maize'
inference_pipeline.step11: Post-process classification: softmax → argmax → class name
inference_pipeline.step13: Compute Grad-CAM++ heatmap on classification output
inference_pipeline.step14: Display: green boundary contour + amber heatmap + class + severity

android_notes.image_input: Use TensorImage with ImageProcessor for resize+normalize
android_notes.thread_note: Run inference on background thread, post results to UI thread
android_notes.gpu_delegate: Optional: use GpuDelegate for faster inference on supported devices
